sentences.text: The case comes up on an application for disposal of the writ petition in the light of judgment passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court on 07.09.2021.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in the light of judgment passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court, he does not want to press the ground of section 24 (2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in the Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act,
2013.
